Strategy: Score favors the bin whose residual exceeds the smallest feasible residual by about one item size, so the choice is anchored to the tightest bin plus a repeat slot. It differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin itself is not the one-plus-item bin. It may help by spreading placements one step above the tightest bin, or fail because the anchor bin may be an outlier.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs((r - min(bins)) - item) for r in bins]
```
